# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Units: metal, Pressure: bar, Temperature: K, Distance: Angstrom

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure
read_data       silicon.data

# Replicate structure 3x3x3
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# Thermodynamic output
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# Heating phase: 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps (1000 ps = 1,000,000 steps)
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             1000000
unfix           1

# Equilibration phase at 2500K for 500 ps (500,000 steps)
reset_timestep  0
fix             2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Compute MSD for diffusion coefficient calculation
compute         msd all msd com yes
fix             msd_output all ave/time 100 1 100 c_msd[1] c_msd[2] c_msd[3] c_msd[4] file msd.dat

run             500000

# Write final configuration
write_data      final.data

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('/results/react/silicon_melting_2_trial_2/msd_data.txt')

# Extract columns: step, msd_x, msd_y, msd_z, msd_total
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_total = data[:, 4]

# Convert steps to time (timestep = 0.001 ps)
time_ps = steps * 0.001  # in picoseconds

# For diffusion coefficient calculation, we need the linear regime
# Typically, we skip the initial ballistic regime and use the later linear part
# Let's use the second half of the data for fitting
start_idx = len(time_ps) // 2
time_fit = time_ps[start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd_total[start_idx:]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6Dt (in 3D)
# slope = 6D
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_fit, msd_fit)

print(f"Linear fit results:")
print(f"  Slope: {slope:.6f} Ų/ps")
print(f"  Intercept: {intercept:.6f} Ų")
print(f"  R²: {r_value**2:.6f}")
print(f"  Standard error: {std_err:.6e}")

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6
D_metal = slope / 6.0  # in Ų/ps

print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient in metal units: {D_metal:.6e} Ų/ps")

# Convert to m²/s
# 1 Ų = 1e-20 m²
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# D[m²/s] = D[Ų/ps] × (1e-20 m²/Ų) / (1e-12 s/ps) = D[Ų/ps] × 1e-8

plt.plot(time_ps, msd_total, 'b-', label='MSD data', alpha=0.7)
plt.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (R² = {r_value**2:.4f})')

print("\nPlot saved to: msd_plot.png")

    f.write(f"  R²: {r_value**2:.6f}\n")
    f.write(f"  Standard error: {std_err:.6e}\n\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient (D = slope/6):\n")
    f.write(f"  In metal units: {D_metal:.6e} Ų/ps\n")
    f.write(f"  In SI units: {D_SI:.6e} m²/s\n\n")
    f.write(f"Final answer: {D_SI:.2e}\n")

print("\nResults saved to: diffusion_coefficient.txt")

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', comments='#')

# Extract columns: step, MSD_x, MSD_y, MSD_z, MSD_total
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD

# Convert steps to time (timestep = 0.001 ps)
time_ps = steps * 0.001

# Plot MSD vs time to visualize
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom^2)')
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time')
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

# For diffusion coefficient calculation, use the linear region
# Skip initial transient (first 10% of data) and use the rest
skip_points = int(len(time_ps) * 0.1)
time_fit = time_ps[skip_points:]
msd_fit = msd_total[skip_points:]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t (Einstein relation)

print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient:")
print(f"  D = {D_A2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"  D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"\nFinal answer: {D_m2_s:.2e}")

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting and diffusion calculation
# Task: Heat silicon from 300K to 2500K, equilibrate, and compute diffusion coefficient

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data silicon.data
replicate 3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Define neighbor list
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Thermodynamic output settings
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# Timestep
timestep 0.001  # 1 fs

# Initialize velocities at 300K
velocity all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

# Stage 1: Heating from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps under NPT
# Temperature change: 2200K, Rate: 2.2 K/ps, Time: 1000 ps = 1,000,000 steps
fix 1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
run 1000000
unfix 1

# Stage 2: Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps under NPT
# Reset time and setup MSD computation
reset_timestep 0

# Compute MSD for diffusion coefficient
compute msd all msd com yes

# Output MSD data
fix 2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
fix 3 all ave/time 100 1 100 c_msd[1] c_msd[2] c_msd[3] c_msd[4] file msd.dat

thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol c_msd[4]

run 500000

write_data final_structure.data

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', comments='#')
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD

# Convert steps to time (ps)
# timestep = 0.001 ps, output every 100 steps
dt = 0.001  # ps
output_freq = 100
time = steps * dt  # time in ps

print(f"Total data points: {len(time)}")
print(f"Time range: {time[0]:.2f} - {time[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"MSD range: {msd_total[0]:.2e} - {msd_total[-1]:.2e} Angstrom^2")

# Plot full MSD vs time
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=0.5)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom^2)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time', fontsize=14)
plt.grid(true, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_vs_time.png', dpi=150)
plt.close()

print("\nPlot saved as msd_vs_time.png")

# For diffusion coefficient calculation, use the linear regime
# Typically skip the initial ballistic regime (first ~10-20% of data)
# and use the middle portion for fitting

# Use middle 60% of data for linear fitting
start_idx = int(0.2 * len(time))
end_idx = int(0.8 * len(time))

time_fit = time[start_idx:end_idx]
msd_fit = msd_total[start_idx:end_idx]

print(f"\nFitting range: {time_fit[0]:.2f} - {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"Number of points for fitting: {len(time_fit)}")

# Linear regression: MSD = 6*D*t
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_fit, msd_fit)

print(f"\nLinear fit results:")
print(f"Slope: {slope:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept:.6e} Angstrom^2")
print(f"R^2: {r_value**2:.6f}")
print(f"Standard error: {std_err:.6e}")

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6 (for 3D)
D_angstrom_ps = slope / 6.0
print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient:")
print(f"D = {D_angstrom_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# 1 Angstrom^2/ps = 1e-20 m^2 / 1e-12 s = 1e-8 m^2/s
D_m2_s = D_angstrom_ps * 1e-8
print(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")

# Plot fit
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, msd_fit, 'r-', linewidth=1.5, label='Fitting region')
plt.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'g--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit: slope={slope:.2e}')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom^2)', fontsize=12)
plt.title(f'MSD Linear Fit (D = {D_m2_s:.2e} m^2/s)', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(true, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_fit.png', dpi=150)
plt.close()

print("\nFit plot saved as msd_fit.png")

# Save result to file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"="*50 + "\n\n")
    f.write(f"Slope of MSD vs time: {slope:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps\n")

    f.write(f"\nDiffusion coefficient (D):\n")
    f.write(f"  D = {D_angstrom_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"  D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"\nFinal answer: {D_m2_s:.2e}\n")

print(f"\nResults saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")
print(f"\n{'='*50}")
print(f"FINAL ANSWER: {D_m2_s:.2e} m^2/s")
print(f"{'='*50}")

import numpy as np

msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD

# timestep = 0.001 ps, output every 100 steps
dt = 0.001  # ps
output_freq = 100
time = steps * dt  # time in ps

print(f"Total data points: {len(time)}")
print(f"Time range: {time[0]:.2f} - {time[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"MSD range: {msd_total[0]:.2e} - {msd_total[-1]:.2e} Angstrom^2")

# Plot full MSD vs time
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=0.5)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom^2)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time', fontsize=14)
plt.grid(true, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_vs_time.png', dpi=150)
plt.close()

print("\nPlot saved as msd_vs_time.png")

# For diffusion coefficient calculation, use the linear regime
# Typically skip the initial ballistic regime (first ~10-20% of data)
# and use the middle portion for fitting

# Use middle 60% of data for linear fitting
start_idx = int(0.2 * len(time))
end_idx = int(0.8 * len(time))

time_fit = time[start_idx:end_idx]
msd_fit = msd_total[start_idx:end_idx]

print(f"\nFitting range: {time_fit[0]:.2f} - {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"Number of points for fitting: {len(time_fit)}")

slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_fit, msd_fit)

print(f"\nLinear fit results:")
print(f"Slope: {slope:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept:.6e} Angstrom^2")
print(f"R^2: {r_value**2:.6f}")
print(f"Standard error: {std_err:.6e}")

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6 (for 3D)
D_angstrom_ps = slope / 6.0
print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient:")
print(f"D = {D_angstrom_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m

D_m2_s = D_angstrom_ps * 1e-8
print(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")

# Plot fit
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5, label='MSD data')

         label=f'Linear fit: slope={slope:.2e}')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom^2)', fontsize=12)
plt.title(f'MSD Linear Fit (D = {D_m2_s:.2e} m^2/s)', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(true, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_fit.png', dpi=150)
plt.close()

print("\nFit plot saved as msd_fit.png")

    f.write(f"  D = {D_angstrom_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"  D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"\nFinal answer: {D_m2_s:.2e}\n")

print(f"\nResults saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")
print(f"\n{'='*50}")
print(f"FINAL ANSWER: {D_m2_s:.2e} m^2/s")
print(f"{'='*50}")

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read MSD data
data = pd.read_csv('msd_data.csv')

# Extract relevant columns
step = data['Step'].values
msd_total = data['c_msd[4]'].values  # Total MSD

# Convert step to time (ps)
# timestep = 0.001 ps, thermo output every 100 steps
time = step * 0.001  # in ps

# Print data info
print(f"Number of data points: {len(time)}")
print(f"Time range: {time[0]} to {time[-1]} ps")
print(f"MSD range: {msd_total[0]} to {msd_total[-1]} Angstrom^2")

# Use the linear region (skip initial transient)
# Typically use data after 10-20% of the run
skip_fraction = 0.1
start_idx = int(len(time) * skip_fraction)

time_fit = time[start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd_total[start_idx:]

print(f"\nUsing data from {time_fit[0]} to {time_fit[-1]} ps for fitting")

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t
# So slope = 6*D
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_fit, msd_fit)

print(f"\nLinear fit results:")
print(f"Slope: {slope} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept} Angstrom^2")
print(f"R-squared: {r_value**2}")

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6
D_angstrom_ps = slope / 6.0  # in Angstrom^2/ps

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 Angstrom^2/ps = 1e-20 m^2 / 1e-12 s = 1e-8 m^2/s
D_m2_s = D_angstrom_ps * 1e-8

print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient:")
print(f"D = {D_angstrom_ps:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")

# Create plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd_total, 'b.', markersize=2, label='MSD data', alpha=0.5)
plt.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r-', linewidth=2, label=f'Linear fit (R²={r_value**2:.4f})')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title(f'Mean Squared Displacement vs Time\nD = {D_m2_s:.3e} m²/s', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Save result to file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"\nFitting details:\n")
    f.write(f"Slope = {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"R-squared = {r_value**2:.6f}\n")
    f.write(f"Data range used: {time_fit[0]:.1f} to {time_fit[-1]:.1f} ps\n")

print("\nResults saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")
print(f"\nFinal answer: {D_m2_s:.2e}")
"}</action_input>

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd.dat', comments='#')
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD (column 4)

# Convert steps to time (ps)
# timestep = 0.001 ps, output every 1000 steps
time = steps * 0.001  # in ps

# For diffusion coefficient calculation, we need the linear regime
# Typically, we skip the initial transient and use the latter part
# Let's use the last 80% of the data for fitting
start_idx = int(0.2 * len(time))
time_fit = time[start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd_total[start_idx:]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6Dt (in 3D)
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_fit, msd_fit)

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6
# Units: slope is in Å²/ps
# Convert to m²/s: 1 Å²/ps = 10^-20 m² / 10^-12 s = 10^-8 m²/s
D_angstrom_ps = slope / 6.0
D_m2_s = D_angstrom_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Linear fit results (last 80% of data):")
print(f"Slope: {slope:.6e} Å²/ps")
print(f"R²: {r_value**2:.6f}")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_angstrom_ps:.6e} Å²/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s")
print(f"\nFinal answer: {D_m2_s:.2e}")

# Create plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r--', linewidth=2, label=f'Linear fit (R²={r_value**2:.4f})')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)', fontsize=12)
plt.title(f'Mean Squared Displacement of Liquid Si at 2500K\nD = {D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Save the diffusion coefficient to a file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"{D_m2_s:.2e}\n")"}</action_input>

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Task: Calculate self-diffusion coefficient at 2500K

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data si_structure.data
replicate 3 3 3

# Define potential (Stillinger-Weber)
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 0 every 1 check yes

# Timestep (1 fs in metal units)
timestep 0.001

# Thermodynamic output
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# ========================================

fix npt_heat all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)

# ========================================

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting and diffusion coefficient calculation
# Units: metal (Angstroms, eV, ps, etc.)

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data       si.data
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber for Si
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Define groups
group           all type 1

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# Thermodynamic output
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# Velocity initialization at 300K
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

# Stage 1: Heating from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps under NPT
# Heating time = (2500-300)/2.2 = 1000 ps = 1000000 steps
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
run             1000000
unfix           1

# Stage 2: Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps under NPT
# Reset timestep counter for cleaner analysis
reset_timestep  0

# NPT equilibration at 2500K
fix             2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)

# Compute MSD for diffusion coefficient
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Output MSD data
fix             msd_output all print 100 "$(step) $(c_msd[1]) $(c_msd[2]) $(c_msd[3]) $(c_msd[4])" &
                file msd_data.txt screen no title "# step msd_x msd_y msd_z msd_total"

# Run equilibration
run             500000

# Clean up
unfix           2
unfix           msd_output

print           "Simulation completed successfully"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd.dat', comments='#')
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD (column 4)

# Convert steps to time (ps)
# timestep = 0.001 ps, output every 1000 steps
time = steps * 0.001  # in ps

# For diffusion coefficient calculation, we need the linear regime
# Typically, we skip the initial transient and use the latter part
# Let's use the last 80% of the data for fitting
start_idx = int(0.2 * len(time))
time_fit = time[start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd_total[start_idx:]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6Dt (in 3D)
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_fit, msd_fit)

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6
# Units: slope is in Å²/ps
# Convert to m²/s: 1 Å²/ps = 10^-20 m² / 10^-12 s = 10^-8 m²/s
D_angstrom_ps = slope / 6.0
D_m2_s = D_angstrom_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Linear fit results (last 80% of data):")
print(f"Slope: {slope:.6e} Å²/ps")
print(f"R²: {r_value**2:.6f}")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_angstrom_ps:.6e} Å²/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s")
print(f"\nFinal answer: {D_m2_s:.2e}")

# Create plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r--', linewidth=2, label=f'Linear fit (R²={r_value**2:.4f})')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)', fontsize=12)
plt.title(f'Mean Squared Displacement of Liquid Si at 2500K\nD = {D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(true, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Save the diffusion coefficient to a file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"{D_m2_s:.2e}\n")

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', comments='#')
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_x = data[:, 1]
msd_y = data[:, 2]
msd_z = data[:, 3]
msd_total = data[:, 4]

# Convert steps to time (ps)
# timestep = 0.001 ps, output every 100 steps
timestep = 0.001  # ps
output_freq = 100
time = steps * timestep  # in ps

print(f"Total data points: {len(time)}")
print(f"Time range: {time[0]:.2f} to {time[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"MSD range: {msd_total[0]:.2f} to {msd_total[-1]:.2f} Å²")

# For diffusion coefficient calculation, we use the Einstein relation:
# MSD = 6*D*t (for 3D)
# D = MSD / (6*t)
# We need to fit the linear region of MSD vs time

# Skip initial transient (first 20% of data) and use middle portion for fitting
skip_fraction = 0.2
use_fraction = 0.6  # use 60% of data after skipping initial 20%

start_idx = int(len(time) * skip_fraction)
end_idx = int(len(time) * (skip_fraction + use_fraction))

time_fit = time[start_idx:end_idx]
msd_fit = msd_total[start_idx:end_idx]

print(f"\nFitting range: {time_fit[0]:.2f} to {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"Number of points used for fitting: {len(time_fit)}")

# Linear regression: MSD = slope * t + intercept
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_fit, msd_fit)

print(f"\nLinear fit results:")
print(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Å²/ps")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept:.6f} Å²")
print(f"R²: {r_value**2:.6f}")
print(f"Standard error: {std_err:.6f}")

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6 (from MSD = 6*D*t)
D_metal = slope / 6.0  # in Å²/ps

print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient (LAMMPS metal units): {D_metal:.6e} Å²/ps")

# Convert to m²/s
# 1 Å = 1e-10 m, 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# D [m²/s] = D [Å²/ps] × (1e-10)² / (1e-12) = D [Å²/ps] × 1e-8
D_SI = D_metal * 1e-8  # in m²/s

print(f"Diffusion coefficient (SI units): {D_SI:.6e} m²/s")

# Plot MSD vs time
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data', alpha=0.7)
plt.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r-', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (R²={r_value**2:.4f})')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time for Liquid Si at 2500K', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Save results to file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion Coefficient Analysis for Liquid Silicon at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"="*60 + "\n\n")
    f.write(f"Fitting parameters:\n")
    f.write(f"  Time range: {time_fit[0]:.2f} to {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps\n")
    f.write(f"  Number of points: {len(time_fit)}\n")
    f.write(f"  Slope: {slope:.6f} Å²/ps\n")
    f.write(f"  R²: {r_value**2:.6f}\n\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient:\n")
    f.write(f"  D = {D_metal:.6e} Å²/ps\n")
    f.write(f"  D = {D_SI:.6e} m²/s\n")

print("\nResults saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")
print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"FINAL ANSWER: {D_SI:.2e}")
print(f"{'='*60}")
"}</action_input>

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Task: Calculate self-diffusion coefficient at 2500K

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data       si.data
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential (Stillinger-Weber)
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Settings
neighbor        0.3 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Define compute for MSD (for all atoms)
compute         msd_compute all msd com yes

# Thermodynamic output settings
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# ===== STAGE 1: Initial minimization =====
min_style       cg
minimize        1.0e-6 1.0e-8 10000 100000

# ===== STAGE 2: Heating from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps =====
# Heating rate: 2.2 K/ps, Temperature change: 2200K, Time: 1000 ps = 1,000,000 steps (dt=0.001 ps)
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix             heat_npt all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
timestep        0.001
run             1000000
unfix           heat_npt

# ===== STAGE 3: Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps =====

uncompute       msd_compute
compute         msd_compute all msd com yes

fix             equil_npt all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', comments='#')
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_x = data[:, 1]
msd_y = data[:, 2]
msd_z = data[:, 3]
msd_total = data[:, 4]

# Convert steps to time (ps)
# timestep = 0.001 ps, output every 100 steps
timestep = 0.001  # ps
output_freq = 100
time = steps * timestep  # in ps

print(f"Total data points: {len(time)}")
print(f"Time range: {time[0]:.2f} to {time[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"MSD range: {msd_total[0]:.2f} to {msd_total[-1]:.2f} Å²")

# For diffusion coefficient calculation, we use the Einstein relation:
# MSD = 6*D*t (for 3D)
# D = MSD / (6*t)
# We need to fit the linear region of MSD vs time

# Skip initial transient (first 20% of data) and use middle portion for fitting
skip_fraction = 0.2
use_fraction = 0.6  # use 60% of data after skipping initial 20%

start_idx = int(len(time) * skip_fraction)
end_idx = int(len(time) * (skip_fraction + use_fraction))

time_fit = time[start_idx:end_idx]
msd_fit = msd_total[start_idx:end_idx]

print(f"\nFitting range: {time_fit[0]:.2f} to {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"Number of points used for fitting: {len(time_fit)}")

# Linear regression: MSD = slope * t + intercept
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_fit, msd_fit)

print(f"\nLinear fit results:")
print(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Å²/ps")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept:.6f} Å²")
print(f"R²: {r_value**2:.6f}")
print(f"Standard error: {std_err:.6f}")

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6 (from MSD = 6*D*t)
D_metal = slope / 6.0  # in Å²/ps

print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient (LAMMPS metal units): {D_metal:.6e} Å²/ps")

# Convert to m²/s
# 1 Å = 1e-10 m, 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# D [m²/s] = D [Å²/ps] × (1e-10)² / (1e-12) = D [Å²/ps] × 1e-8
D_SI = D_metal * 1e-8  # in m²/s

print(f"Diffusion coefficient (SI units): {D_SI:.6e} m²/s")

# Plot MSD vs time
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data', alpha=0.7)
plt.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r-', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (R²={r_value**2:.4f})')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time for Liquid Si at 2500K', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(true, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Save results to file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion Coefficient Analysis for Liquid Silicon at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"="*60 + "\n\n")
    f.write(f"Fitting parameters:\n")
    f.write(f"  Time range: {time_fit[0]:.2f} to {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps\n")
    f.write(f"  Number of points: {len(time_fit)}\n")
    f.write(f"  Slope: {slope:.6f} Å²/ps\n")
    f.write(f"  R²: {r_value**2:.6f}\n\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient:\n")
    f.write(f"  D = {D_metal:.6e} Å²/ps\n")
    f.write(f"  D = {D_SI:.6e} m²/s\n")

print("\nResults saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")
print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"FINAL ANSWER: {D_SI:.2e}")
print(f"{'='*60}")

# LAMMPS input script for melting silicon and computing diffusion coefficient
# Units: metal (eV, Angstrom, ps, K)

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data       si_structure.data
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Set mass (for Si)
mass            1 28.0855

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs in metal units

# Thermodynamic output
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# Stage 1: Initial equilibration at 300K (NPT)
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             10000  # 10 ps equilibration
unfix           1

# Stage 2: Heating from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps
# Time needed: (2500-300)/2.2 = 1000 ps = 1000000 steps
fix             2 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             1000000  # 1000 ps heating
unfix           2

# Stage 3: Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps
fix             3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             500000  # 500 ps equilibration
unfix           3

# Stage 4: Production run at 2500K with MSD calculation
# Reset timestep for MSD calculation
reset_timestep  0

# Compute MSD for all atoms
compute         msd_all all msd com yes

# Output MSD data
fix             4 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
fix             msd_output all print 1000 "${step} $(c_msd_all[1]) $(c_msd_all[2]) $(c_msd_all[3]) $(c_msd_all[4])" &
                file msd_data.txt screen no title "# Step MSD_x MSD_y MSD_z MSD_total"

thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol c_msd_all[4]

# Run for 500 ps to collect MSD data
run             500000

unfix           4
unfix           msd_output

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Task: Calculate self-diffusion coefficient at 2500K

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data       si.data
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential (Stillinger-Weber)
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# Thermodynamic output
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# Velocity initialization at 300K
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

# Heating phase: 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps (1000 ps = 1,000,000 steps)
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
run             1000000
unfix           1

# Equilibration phase at 2500K for 500 ps (500,000 steps)
reset_timestep  0

# Compute MSD for diffusion coefficient calculation
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Output MSD data
fix             2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
fix             msd_output all print 100 "${step} $(c_msd[1]) $(c_msd[2]) $(c_msd[3]) $(c_msd[4])" &
                file msd_data.txt screen no title "# Step MSD_x MSD_y MSD_z MSD_total"

run             500000

unfix           2
unfix           msd_output

print           "Simulation completed successfully"

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read MSD data
# Format: timestep, msd_x, msd_y, msd_z, msd_total
data = np.loadtxt('msd.dat')

# Extract timestep and total MSD
timesteps = data[:, 0]
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert timesteps to time in picoseconds (timestep = 0.001 ps)
time_ps = timesteps * 0.001

# Convert time to seconds
time_s = time_ps * 1e-12

# Convert MSD from Angstrom^2 to m^2
msd_m2 = msd_total * 1e-20

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

plt.grid(True)

plt.close()

# Typically, we skip the initial ballistic regime and use the later part

start_idx = int(0.2 * len(time_s))

plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom^2)')
plt.title('MSD vs Time with Linear Fit')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.savefig('msd_with_fit.png', dpi=150)

print("Plots saved as msd_plot.png and msd_with_fit.png")
"}</action_input>

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting and diffusion coefficient calculation
# Task: Heat silicon from 300K to 2500K, equilibrate, and calculate diffusion coefficient

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      atomic
boundary        p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data       si_structure.data
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential (Stillinger-Weber)
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# Thermodynamic output
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# Heating phase: 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps (1000 ps = 1,000,000 steps)
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
run             1000000
unfix           1

# Reset timestep for equilibration phase
reset_timestep  0

# Equilibration phase at 2500K for 500 ps (500,000 steps)
# Compute MSD for diffusion coefficient calculation
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Output MSD data
fix             2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
fix             msd_output all print 100 "$(step) $(c_msd[1]) $(c_msd[2]) $(c_msd[3]) $(c_msd[4])" file msd_data.txt screen no title "# Step MSD_x MSD_y MSD_z MSD_total"

run             500000

unfix           2
unfix           msd_output

print           "Simulation completed successfully"

Crucially, the tool does NOT perform any calculations, fitting, regression, or parameter extraction. If the query requires a computed or inferred quantity rather than a directly readable or visually observable feature, the tool will refuse and state that it can only provide visual descriptions and directly readable values. Because the tool relies on a vision-language model and a rendered image, its answers are inherently approximate, potentially noisy, and may sometimes be incorrect or incomplete. The quality and reliability of the response depend strongly on image resolution, plot clarity, axis labeling, marker density, and overall figure design. Users should treat the output as a qualitative, assistive interpretation and should validate important conclusions using proper quantitative analysis tools or the underlying data.

When to use: When to use this tool:

    - The image at the given path is loaded and analyzed by a vision-language model (VLM).
    - The model performs visual inspection only: it looks at shapes, trends, patterns, and visibly identifiable features in the figure.
    - The model may report approximate values only when they can be directly read from the axes at a clearly visible feature (e.g., a labeled tick near a visible transition).
    - The model does not have access to the underlying data and does not perform any numerical computation, fitting, or measurement.
    - Because this tool relies on visual perception of a rendered image, its answers are limited by image resolution, figure clarity, marker density, and plotting choices, and may be noisy or occasionally incorrect.

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd.dat', comments='#')
timestep = data[:, 0]  # in timesteps
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # total MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert timestep to time in picoseconds
# timestep = 0.001 ps, output every 100 steps
time_ps = timestep * 0.001 * 100  # time in ps

# For diffusion coefficient calculation, we need the linear region
# Typically use the last 50-70% of the data
start_idx = int(0.3 * len(time_ps))  # Start from 30% to avoid initial transient
end_idx = len(time_ps)

time_linear = time_ps[start_idx:end_idx]
msd_linear = msd_total[start_idx:end_idx]

# Perform linear regression on MSD vs time
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_linear, msd_linear)

print(f"Linear fit from {time_linear[0]:.1f} ps to {time_linear[-1]:.1f} ps")
print(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"R^2: {r_value**2:.6f}")

# Calculate diffusion coefficient using Einstein relation
# D = MSD / (6t) for 3D diffusion
# slope = d(MSD)/dt, so D = slope / 6
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0  # in Angstrom^2/ps

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 Angstrom^2/ps = 1e-20 m^2 / 1e-12 s = 1e-8 m^2/s
D_m2_s = D_A2_ps * 1e-8

print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient:")
print(f"D = {D_A2_ps:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"D = {D_m2_s:.10e} m^2/s (full precision)")

# Plot MSD vs time
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd_total, 'b-', label='MSD data', linewidth=1)
plt.plot(time_linear, slope * time_linear + intercept, 'r--', 
         label=f'Linear fit (R²={r_value**2:.4f})', linewidth=2)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(true, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Save the result
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"Linear fit range: {time_linear[0]:.1f} ps to {time_linear[-1]:.1f} ps\n")
    f.write(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"R^2: {r_value**2:.6f}\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_A2_ps:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_m2_s:.10e} m^2/s\n")

print("\nResults saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")
